description: This Java test utility class manages creation and shutdown of Akka actor systems for unit testing purposes. It provides a static method to run tests within an isolated actor system and a functional interface for test assertions.

classes.name: DittoTestSystem
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of an Akka ActorSystem for testing, implementing AutoCloseable to ensure proper shutdown.

classes.name: DittoTestSystem.TestConsumer
classes.description: A functional interface for executing test assertions within the context of the ActorSystem's TestKit.

methods.name: DittoTestSystem.run
methods.description: Creates a new actor system, runs the provided assertions within a TestKit context, and ensures proper shutdown afterward.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem when the DittoTestSystem is closed.
